The '''Caloria Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that was located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The route was the primary passage through the [[Reena Province]], and connected the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Tavitz system/Legends|Tavitz]], [[Tillo system/Legends|Tillo]], [[Reena/Legends|Reena]] where it intersected the [[Procopian Shipping Lane]], [[Tanger]], [[Caloria/Legends|Caloria]] and [[Canti system/Legends|Canti]].
